description: R-03: the whole RSVP write decision as data. `read` pins the lenient read of the sections RSVP uses (rsvp, events with durable ids, registrationForm; zod 3.24.4 semantics: JavaScript trim, UTF-16 lengths, WHATWG URLs, the datetime pattern), projected to what the rules need. `guest` runs lib/invitation/rsvp-decision.ts decideGuestRsvp on the stored config after the lenient read (a write without `rsvpAnswers` / `rsvpEventAnswers` leaves that column untouched; null clears it). `host` runs decideHostRsvp. Expected values were derived by hand from the rules and confirmed against the TypeScript at 87e14dc + R-03; tests/rsvp-decisions.test.ts and services/api/tests/rsvp_vectors.rs run this file.
